name: Novixa Addons for Elementor
author: Ali Hossain

sections.description:
Novixa Addons is an independent collection of lightweight, design-focused widgets for Elementor, with a clean dashboard for enabling only the elements you need. Every widget lives in its own module, so disabling the ones you don’t use keeps your site fast and your Elementor panel uncluttered.

All settings live under Novixa Addons in your wp-admin menu, with an Elements screen for toggling widgets on/off individually.

Text & Headings

  • Heading — flexible heading with highlighted text, sub-title, text stroke/shadow and blend mode.
  • Dual Color Heading — one heading, two text runs with independent colors and typography.
  • Gradient Text Effect — heading with an adjustable two-color gradient on the middle text.
  • Text Editor — rich text with drop cap, columns and full typography controls.

Buttons

  • Button — blob-hover button with Modern Solid and Modern Outline skins.
  • Overlay Button — a color chip expands to fill the button on hover.
  • Icon Badge Button — pill button with a colored icon badge and four hover effects.

Icon Boxes & Feature Cards

  • Icon Box — luxury icon box with icon shapes and hover lift.
  • Diamond Icon Box — icon box with a rotated diamond-outline icon.
  • Image Box — image box with hover zoom/grayscale and flexible layout.
  • Feature Card — service card with title, text and an overlapping CTA button.
  • Numbered Feature Box — dark card with icon badge and large step number.
  • Image Caption Card — full-bleed image card that can double as a call-to-action.
  • Content Reveal on Hover — image card that reveals its text and buttons on hover or focus.

Accordions & Tabs

  • Accordion — plus/minus accordion with optional FAQ schema (JSON-LD).
  • Icon Accordion — expandable panels with an icon, heading and content each.
  • Tabs — labeled tabs with direction, justify and title alignment controls.
  • Tabs (Nested, Experimental) — tabs whose panels are real Elementor containers.

Counters & Stats

  • Counter — animated count-up number with icon, prefix/suffix and title.
  • Progress Bar & Skill Chart — animated bars, circular rings and gauges in six styles.
  • Countdown Timer — nine-preset countdown with timezones, CTA and expired state.
  • Liquid Counter — circular stat badge with an animated liquid-fill wave.

Marquees & Carousels

  • List Marquee — endless ticker of short items such as offers and announcements.
  • Logo Marquee — endless row of logo cards with captions and links.
  • Images Marquee — endless photo strip without card frames.
  • Logo Carousel — paginated logo slider with arrows, dots and autoplay.
  • Testimonial Carousel — premium review slider with nine presets, star ratings, autoplay, filter and optional review schema.

Images & Comparisons

  • Before / After — draggable image-comparison slider.
  • Image Gallery — filterable grid or masonry gallery with a built-in lightbox.
  • Image Hotspot — image with unlimited interactive hotspots and tooltips.

Blog & Posts

  • Post List — post loop with four skins, filters, AJAX pagination and a Related Posts mode.

Search & Tooltips

  • Universal Search — AJAX live search across posts, products and custom fields with six designs.
  • Tooltip — hover, click or focus tooltips with six presets and keyboard support.

Team & People

  • Team Member — ten presets (Modern Profile Card, Luxury Gold, Minimal, Image Overlay, Glassmorphism, Split, Circular, Dark Premium, Social Reveal, Flip Card), grid/carousel/list layouts, social icons, skills and hover effects.

Maps & Timelines

  • Geotag Hub — central pin with unlimited points linked by flowing arrows.
  • Luxury Timeline — gold-line timeline with alternating content and scroll reveal.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the novixa-addons-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
  4. Go to Novixa Addons > Elements to enable the widgets you want.
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor (free version) must be installed and active.

Can I disable widgets I don’t use?

Yes, go to Novixa Addons > Elements and toggle any widget off. Disabled widgets are not loaded on the front end.
sections.changelog:
1.5.6

  • Fix: Nested Tabs (Experimental) – tab content containers were not shown in the editor canvas (and the Add Tab fix never ran) on Elementor 4.x, because Elementor fires its nested-elements-loaded event before the add-on script runs. The widget now registers itself immediately when Elementor’s nested module is already loaded.
  • Fix: Nested Tabs – a newly added tab is now named “Tab #N” instead of “Tab”.
  • New: Team Member image Height, Max Height and Min Height controls.
  • New: Team Member biography Max Lines control to keep cards short.
  • New: Team Member social links – 3 default fields per member (Facebook, X, LinkedIn) plus an “Add Icon” repeater (Content > Social Links > Extra Icons) to add unlimited extra icons to all members or to a chosen member.
  • New widget: Team Member
